scope: Stage 4 evidence, startup through decisions 4 and 8 only. Fixed before exhaustive enumeration. The velocity threshold was exploratory on the earlier one-word audit; this wider check is not a blind novelty review.
axis: one-axis ZOH, known zero inputs; [p;v], p in m, v in m/s
language: For s=0..k, from empty queue and zero initial consecutive misses, use absent generation or delay 0,1,2 with no consecutive absent generations. Exogenous. Every generated packet eventually delivered; prefixes admitting later deliveries extend by on-time generation thereafter.

policies.keep: Use all packets delivered through decision k before acting.
policies.drop: Use the same delivery record but discard value of s if receipt exceeds 4*(floor(s/4)+1); retain deliveries exactly on boundary. Keep every other available constraint.

outcomes: Worst over all compatible continuous values and all allowed prefixes for each coordinate. Accept at each tested boundary only if the same feasible posterior point can meet both radii. Include a no-strict-crossing control and the original one-word witness. No change of thresholds after enumeration. No infinite-horizon conclusion.
